events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A one-day eos × NYLON NYFW truck activation introducing eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free public access, Dewy Lip Shine sampling and sweet treats while supplies last. NYLON's promotion says the first 50 guests receive a jelly bag with the full Dewy Lip Shine collection and also promotes ice pops.
events.caveats: Current NYC event listings agree on September 15, 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway and describe the activation as open to the public. NYLON's current promotional email says freebies are first-come, first-served while supplies last. No RSVP requirement was established in the sources verified in this pass.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation from 12–5 PM. Arrive near opening if the first-50 full-collection jelly bag is the priority; samples and treats are while supplies last.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day Mary Kay public beauty experience at Gansevoort Plaza built around an oversized vanity, beauty touch-ups, product discovery and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Mary Kay's organizer Eventbrite advertises 10,000 free makeup and skincare products to give away; current event coverage also advertises beauty touch-ups and interactive photo moments.
events.caveats: The Eventbrite page is organized by Mary Kay U.S. and confirms September 15, 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. Secondary current listings describe the experience as free/open to the public. Because an organizer registration page is available, use that direct link even though walk-up access is also described publicly; giveaways remain subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Use the Mary Kay organizer Eventbrite link before traveling. The activation runs 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza; product giveaways are finite.

events.event_name: The Nitro Bar × Reese's Pumpkins Pop-Up
events.address: Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Pl, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day public Reese's × The Nitro Bar truck preview for the Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte ahead of The Nitro Bar's planned NYC expansion.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes are advertised as giveaways each day, with Reese's Pumpkins and a recipe card; the first 100 fans in line each day are advertised to receive a limited-edition Reese's × The Nitro Bar koozie.
events.caveats: Fresh September 14 reporting confirms the public can visit beginning at 11 AM on both September 14 and 15 and that offerings are while supplies last. Current listings disagree on a nominal end time (3 PM versus 5 PM), while promotional wording says 11 AM until supplies last; do not promise a fixed closing time.
events.practical_notes: For September 15, treat 11 AM as the reliable start and 'until supplies last' as the actionable end condition. Arrive early for the first-100 koozie or before the daily latte allotment is exhausted.

events.event_name: HeadCount National Voter Registration Day NYC Block Party
events.address: Washington Square Park, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A free National Voter Registration Day block party with voter-registration assistance, brand activations, live music, art and community activities.
events.what_is_free: Free public admission; current event coverage advertises brand freebies and chocolate, and Nixie's activation specifically advertises complimentary zero-sugar soda while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current sources agree on September 15, 10 AM–6 PM at Washington Square Park and describe the event as free/open to the public. Individual brand giveaways are while supplies last. No registration requirement for attending the block party was established in the sources verified in this pass.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public event from 10 AM–6 PM. Brand freebies may run out before the event ends.
